g3-implement.title: G3 hierarchical shrinkage fit (both channels, strictly-pre): implement
g3-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G3. Deliverable: src/physics/fingerprint/fit.py — the slow-offline-loop fit that reads driver_class_observables and writes cells into the G2 store. Hierarchy: field mean -> driver-overall -> class cell + a class-across-drivers PARENT, recency-weighted (half-life from FINGERPRINT_FROZEN over round distance), via fit_two_way(driver x class) + the canonical predictive_t seam (nu_loss=4.0, FormulaRule). as_of_round REQUIRED with NO default. STRICTLY-PRE CUTOFF APPLIES TO THE ENTIRE INPUT SET, NOT ONLY THE TARGET DRIVER: a fit with as_of_round=R filters ALL observable rows to round_idx<=R BEFORE any pooling — target driver AND the class-across-drivers parent AND the field mean (which pool OTHER drivers). Future info must not leak into a cell via the parent/field shrinkage. Fit BOTH channels: time (time_deficit_s; carry g_sigma_onesided as a one-sided sigma+ component; carry sigma_lapsampling as a PRESENT-but-zero sigma component that soft-degrades to 0 while NULL, MIRRORING the G soft-degrade — do NOT silently drop the slot) and energy (deployment_share/deployment_phase_fraction). Thin-cell sigma-widening priced at a SINGLE structural site at fit time, never re-filtered/re-widened downstream. Apply the G1 #675 verdict PER CHANNEL: for each channel whose class-axis coverage generalized as under-covered, floor that channel's class-level sigma via pool_random_effects' shared_floor (the recorded per-channel recommendation) applied exactly once at the single site. Preserve the byte-identical-point invariant under G sigma+=0. Tests tests/unit/physics/fingerprint/test_fit.py (temp DBs): cutoff-leakage KEYSTONE — assert TWO poison forms leave the target cell byte-identical: (a) a TARGET-driver row at round_idx>R, AND (b) a NON-TARGET driver row at round_idx>R (proves the parent/field pooling is also cut) — cite #628's 14.6x materiality precedent in the test docstring; sigma-widening priced-once (re-invoking the pricing op is idempotent AND the pipeline applies it at exactly one site — assert via a single-call structural check); G sigma+=0 byte-identical point; sigma_lapsampling slot present-and-zero; recency weighting; both-channel fit; unresolved status on empty support. Dispatch constellation-implementer; integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
